newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 4-week T-bill auction Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 4-week T-bill auction Wednesday.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of four-week treasury bills on Wednesday, the central bank (NBS) said on Monday.
The ministry does not disclose amounts offered in regular auctions of state securities, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on the bids.

The average yield in the last successful auction of four-week T-bills was 14.21 percent on May 7, up from 13.277 percent in the previous successful auction of similar paper on March 13. -- Bratislava Newsroom, 421-7-521-8402
